objective: Test whether the target-label-free RouterState contains enough transferable signal for a small numeric model to select Standard, MHAR, ensemble, or abstention without an LLM.
evidence_boundary: Retrospective shadow-only method development. Existing datasets are not a newly sealed external programme, so even a passing result cannot promote the router or replace a numerical expert.

edge_inventory.construction: all directed donor-recipient combinations within each compatible suite

learner.alpha_selection: inner group cross-validation minimizing mean squared error over all three expert outcomes
learner.prediction_clip: each predicted Spearman is clipped to [-1, 1]

decision_decoder.expert: argmax of the three predicted expert Spearman values

evaluation.primary_endpoint: median downstream routed Spearman with abstention scored as 0

qualification_gate.useful_edge_retention_definition: fraction of edges with oracle-best Spearman at least 0.25 whose routed realized Spearman is also at least 0.25

promotion_rule: Do not promote. A passing retrospective screen only justifies freezing the numeric router for one newly sealed external programme.
